_comment: Weights are fixed BEFORE scoring and must sum to 1.0. Scores 1-5, higher is always better (cost: 5 = cheapest per minute; vendor dependency: 5 = least dependent). All scores are team estimates without a source, hence placeholder.

quality.rationale: A small team cannot match the visual quality of frontier video models with its own fine-tune.

cost.rationale: Marginal cost per minute is low, but training and compute are amortized over few minutes.

hebrew.rationale: Full control over Hebrew data, but Hebrew voice and lip-sync would have to be built in-house.

dev_time.rationale: Training and evaluating a video model does not fit in a 14-week semester.

vendor.rationale: No dependence on an external provider.

privacy.rationale: All data and weights stay in-house.

alternatives.label_he: ב׳: שכבת סוכנים מעל מודלים מסחריים דרך API

quality.rationale: Commercial models give the best available visual quality today.

cost.rationale: Every generated second is billed, so cost per finished minute is the highest.

hebrew.rationale: Hebrew support depends on each provider and is uneven across image, voice and lip-sync.

dev_time.rationale: Only the agent layer is built; the models are ready-made.

vendor.rationale: Price, API or policy changes of a provider hit the product directly.

privacy.rationale: Scripts and character images are sent to third-party services.

alternatives.label_he: ג׳: היברידי של קוד פתוח ושירות API

quality.rationale: Open-source models for most shots and API only for hard shots: good but below pure API.

cost.rationale: Local generation lowers cost; API is paid only for a minority of shots.

hebrew.rationale: Open Hebrew speech models can be chosen locally, with an API fallback.

dev_time.rationale: Needs GPU setup and routing logic on top of the agent layer.

vendor.rationale: Partial dependence: the API can be replaced by local models for most shots.

privacy.rationale: Most data stays local; only the hard shots leave the system.
